title: Especialista em IA e Business Intelligence
description:
Você é movido por dados, inovação e inteligência artificial?

Se você curte transformar informação em estratégia, desenhar soluções inteligentes e gerar impacto real nos resultados do negócio, essa vaga pode ser para você!

Venha fazer parte do time de UPXers e contribua com a nossa missão de tornar a internet um ambiente mais seguro para empresas e pessoas.

Como Especialista em IA e Business Intelligence , sua missão será liderar iniciativas que ampliem a eficiência do canal de vendas em cibersegurança por meio de automações, modelos preditivos e dashboards estratégicos — fornecendo à liderança insights precisos e acionáveis que impulsionem receita, performance e crescimento.

O desafio envolve combinar visão analítica, domínio técnico e mentalidade experimental para desenvolver soluções escaláveis e com alto impacto, sempre com uma abordagem data-driven, colaborativa e voltada a resultados.

Responsabilidades:

  • Selecionar tecnologias (LLMs, pipelines de dados, Power BI, Looker Studio) e integrá-las às plataformas de marketing, comunicação, vendas e processos de gestão estratégica;
  • Desenvolver frameworks analíticos que priorizem oportunidades de mercado, melhorem o score de leads e apoiem decisões de pricing e go-to-market;
  • Suportar os times com análise de dados, interpretando métricas e apresentando insights que orientem ações de marketing, comunicação e vendas;
  • Transformar processos manuais em fluxos autônomos de coleta, enriquecimento e ativação de dados — do first touch ao churn prevention;
  • Traduzir métricas em storytelling executivo, capacitar times internos e institucionalizar governança e qualidade dos dados;
  • Monitorar o desempenho de modelos e automações, ajustando prompts, parâmetros e consumo de recursos para garantir qualidade, velocidade e custo-benefício.

Requisitos e Perfil:

  • Graduação concluída há pelo menos 2 anos em Engenharia de Dados, Engenharia de TI, Engenharia de Computação ou Ciência de Dados;
  • Conhecimento em SQL, Python e fundamentos de machine learning;
  • Experiência comprovada em Power BI ou Looker Studio (modelagem, DAX/LookML, publicação);
  • Inglês técnico;
  • Interesse por cybersecurity.

Diferenciais:

  • Projetos de IA em produção - documentação do problema, stack utilizada e impacto gerado;
  • Projetos com LLMs, LangChain, RAG ou chatbots;
  • Certificações PL-300 (Power BI Data Analyst), DP-100 (Azure Machine Learning Engineer) ou Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer;
  • Vivência com dados de segurança da informação ou SaaS B2B.
  • Experiência com MLOps, incluindo CI/CD de modelos e monitoramento de drift.

Sobre a UPX:

Com mais de 22 anos de atuação, a UPX é referência em cibersegurança e performance digital, protegendo ambientes críticos com atuação 24x7.

Especialistas em mitigação de ataques DDoS, prevenção de incidentes e entrega de conteúdo com alta performance, atendemos grandes players dos setores financeiro, bancário, operadoras e ISPs — no Brasil e nos EUA.

Contamos com unidades em Campinas (SP) e Miami (EUA), além de uma estrutura robusta com times técnicos de elite em Segurança da Informação, Engenharia de Redes, SOC, NOC e Scrubbing Centers.

Na UPX, trabalhamos todos os dias para tornar a internet mais segura, confiável e eficiente para empresas e pessoas.

No iFood, acreditamos na força da diversidade para gerar #Inovação e alcançar #Resultados incríveis. Queremos ser a empresa onde as pessoas escolham se desenvolver e realizar seus sonhos. #AllTogether.

Temos fome de inovação e resultados. Sempre buscamos fazer o nosso melhor, pensando "fora da caixa" e agindo com agilidade e responsabilidade. Valorizamos a diversidade, o conhecimento e o compartilhamento em um ambiente dinâmico e versátil. O ingrediente especial da nossa receita? As pessoas. Vem fazer parte disso!

title: Global Demand Planner
description:
SWM International is a multinational company specialized in producing paper for the tobacco industry and solutions in specialty papers. We are expert manufacturers of a variety of advanced materials that are part of people’s everyday lives. We contribute to our customers’ success by delivering high-quality products and collaborating to provide innovative and customized solutions that enhance the value of their offerings.

Now, we invite you to be part of our daily journey, where each employee is essential to the success of our company.

Bring your talent to SWM!

We are currently looking for a Global Demand Planner to join our team in a permanent position at our São Paulo office (South Zone) .

Position Objective

The Global Demand Planner is responsible for leading the demand planning process across regions and business units to ensure accurate forecasts, optimize inventory, and align supply with market demand. This role collaborates cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Supply Chain teams to deliver a reliable demand signal that supports business objectives and customer satisfaction.

Your challenges will include:

  1. Develop, maintain, and communicate the global demand forecast at multiple levels of aggregation (product, category, region, customer).
  2. Lead monthly demand planning cycles, including forecast reviews, consensus meetings, and alignment with key stakeholders.
  3. Analyze historical sales data, market trends, promotional activities, and business intelligence to refine forecasts.
  4. Drive continuous improvement in forecast accuracy and bias reduction through advanced planning tools, statistical models, and process enhancements.
  5. Provide insights to senior management on demand trends, risks, and opportunities, enabling data-driven decision-making.
  6. Ensure alignment of the demand plan with financial targets and strategic objectives.
  7. Act as key user for ERP and demand planning systems, supporting enhancements, testing, and best practice adoption.
  8. Prepare and present reports, KPIs, and dashboards to track forecast performance and process effectiveness.

What we’re looking for:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business Administration, Economics, or related field (Master’s degree is a plus).
  • Experience: Solid experience in the role, preferably in multinational environments.
  • Technical Skills: Advanced Excel and proficiency in data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, etc.).
  • Languages: Advanced English (French is a plus).
  • Availability to travel.

What we offer:

  • Family Health Plan (national coverage, employee contribution)
  • Family Dental Plan (national coverage)
  • Food Allowance Card: R$450.00
  • Meal Card
  • Eye Care Assistance (reimbursement up to R$544.00 per year)
  • Life Insurance
  • Transportation Assistance (6% salary deduction)
  • PNR – semiannual bonus (up to one salary every six months)
  • Childcare Assistance (R$478.45 for 24 months after maternity leave return)
  • School Supplies Kit (R$158.00 for children up to 21 years old enrolled in elementary to high school/technical education)
  • Christmas Card: R$370.00
  • Christmas Toy (for employees’ children aged 0 to 12 years)

Working Hours: Administrative Shift

Work Location: SWM Office – South Zone, São Paulo

title: Account Manager, Enterprise Browser
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life. Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters. Job Description

Your Career

You will join an exciting and high growth business unit with Palo Alto Networks positioning the industry’s most comprehensive SASE security platform, with the industry’s broadest security and compliance coverage for applications used by your hybrid workforce, regardless of whether they are at home, on the go, or in the office.

In this role, you will be responsible for managing a territory focusing on Major, Strategic, and Enterprise Accounts. Working closely with Palo Alto business partners and driving sales for our Enterprise Browser security solution, into new and existing customers. It is expected that you deliver or exceed your sales targets in both new business and renewals for ACV and TCV bookings. The role expects you to define your territory, strategies and then lead local execution and in alignment to company strategies and tactics within the Prisma SASE organization.

Your Impact

  • Win new logos, renew existing customer and expand business within your territory
  • Achieve ACV sales quotas on a monthly and quarterly basis
  • Present regular/accurate forecasting for review
  • Track and report on all opportunities, pipeline, and bookings to provide forecast reports to region management
  • Establish relationships and engage with the local reseller and alliance partners on sales programs and joint activities
  • Develop, share and implement standard methodologies and account strategies to increase our sales penetration of Enterprise Browser into our top accounts
  • Engage with customers to identify and progress opportunities whilst delivering subject matter expertise on Enterprise Browser solutions
  • Qualify and progress leads and opportunities through the sales cycle to closure
  • Keep up-to-date knowledge of Enterprise Browser and other browser technologies as well as the competitive position of the company
  • Conduct consistent training and communications for the sales and channel teams as well as joint engagement within the wider organization
  • Contribute to the larger Palo Alto Network’s Prisma SASE strategy by providing regional specific intelligence and reporting
  • Apply subject matter expertise in training, QBRs, enablement, and other engagement activities
  • Gather “Voice of Customer” and competitive intelligence and share with theater and global Prisma SASE organization
  • Help build and project Palo Alto Networks position
Qualifications

Your Experience

  • 4+ years' experience exceeding sales quota as Account Manager, or Territory Account Manager for a multinational company
  • Sales excellence - ability to demonstrate planning, strategy, qualification and execution
  • Prior experience selling SAAS or Cybersecurity network solutions
  • Existing relationships within the region, including top accounts and reseller partners
  • Excellent communication skills including strong verbal and written skills and proven presentation skills being able to articulate complex topics
  • Experience with target account selling, solution selling, and consultative sales techniques
Additional Information

The Team

Palo Alto Networks has brought technology to the market that is reshaping the cybersecurity threat and protection landscape. Our ability to protect digital transactions is limited only by our ability to establish relationships with our potential customers and help them understand how our products can protect their environments. This is where our sales teams come in. Our sales team members work together with large organizations to keep their digital information safe. Our passionate sales teams educate, inspire, and empower our potential clients.

As part of our sales team, you are empowered with unmatched systems and tools, constantly updated research and sales libraries, and a team built on joint success. You won’t find someone at Palo Alto Networks that isn’t committed to your success – with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development. As a member of our sales team, you are driven by a solutions-focused sales environment and find fulfillment in working with clients to resolve incredibly complex cyberthreats. You’re an amazing salesperson – you’re just looking for something more substantial and challenging as your next step.

Our Commitment
We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

title: Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor Role
description:
Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor

Downstream · Open to employees in Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Paraguay, Peru, Suriname, Uruguay, Venezuela

About Downstream

Downstream is transforming the construction industry by building a marketplace for equipment rentals, portable toilets, and roll-off dumpsters. We are scaling fast. Our vision: bring price transparency, automation, and intelligence into one of the most manual, underserved verticals in the economy.

We’re inspired by clean design and modern architecture—and we’re pushing forward with AI-native product thinking, not bolting it on later.

The Role

We’re hiring a Head of Product Design (UI/UX) who is obsessed with creating intuitive, elegant, and impactful user experiences. You’ve shipped something before—whether at a startup that scaled, a product that users loved, or a platform that redefined a workflow. You know the pain of turning complex problems into simple, usable solutions, and you want another shot at shaping an industry from 0 → 1.

At Downstream, you’ll work directly with our CEO, CTO, and Product team to:

  • Define and own the design vision for our marketplace, supplier tools, and customer experience.
  • Lead end-to-end design for web and mobile, including UX flows, UI systems, and visual identity.
  • Architect AI-native product experiences that feel intuitive, not artificial—helping users trust automation and agents in critical workflows.
  • Collaborate with engineers and product managers to ship fast: prototype, test, iterate, and refine.
  • Build and scale our design system so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality.

Responsibilities

  • Drive the product design strategy across customer, supplier, and internal platforms.
  • Build and maintain UI/UX standards that reflect simplicity, trust, and efficiency.
  • Design AI-native experiences—where agentic systems interact seamlessly with users, data, and decisions.
  • Conduct user research and usability testing with construction industry stakeholders.
  • Mentor and grow a design team as we scale.

What We’re Looking For

  • Battle-tested designer: You’ve shipped real products (startup, marketplace, SaaS, or similar).
  • AI-forward mindset: You don’t just add AI—you design around it, making it feel natural and empowering.
  • Builder’s DNA: Comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and iteration. You’ve felt the pain of building in the real world and still want more.
  • Technical & design skills:
  • UI/UX design (Figma, Sketch, or equivalent)
  • Strong UX research and prototyping chops
  • Design systems and component libraries
  • Understanding of modern frontend frameworks (bonus: Flutter, React)
  • Experience designing for AI interactions (chat, agents, workflows)
  • Startup mentality: Hands-on, resourceful, willing to go beyond your job title.
  • Industry experience: Construction tech or marketplaces a huge plus—someone who can empathize with our users.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in marketplaces, logistics, SaaS, or fintech.
  • Familiarity with B2B workflows and procurement tools.

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Full Stack Software Engineer with 5+ years of software development experience. Candidates must have a strong background in React.js and experience with either Golang, Node.js, or Java, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will play a foundational role in building the core platform that enables power utilities to shift from decades-old legacy systems into an AI-native future. Candidates must bring working proficiency with AI tools and APIs to ensure seamless integration of intelligent functionality into the client's products.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.

Responsibilities

  • Front-End Development : Build, implement, and maintain front-end applications
  • Back-End Architecture & Development : Design, implement, and maintain APIs, services, and distributed systems that form the backbone of the client's OS
  • AI Integration : Collaborate with AI engineers to integrate models, embeddings, and agent services into back-end systems. Operate AI APIs, ensuring outputs are production-ready and aligned with enterprise utility requirements.
  • System Modernization : Transform legacy workflows into modern, secure, scalable codebases using cloud-native best practices
  • Security & Compliance : Partner with security leaders to ensure all services adhere to stringent utility-sector regulations, implementing secure coding practices by default
  • Agile Delivery : Deliver features and improvements in cycles measured in weeks, balancing speed with reliability

Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments
  • Strong proficiency in React, Python, and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams
  • Basic proficiency with AI/ML tooling (e.g., calling APIs, integrating model outputs)
  • Solid understanding of databases (SQL and NoSQL), message queues, and distributed architectures
  • Cloud-native engineering experience (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Clear communicator, adaptable, eager to learn and grow AI capabilities over time
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability in small teams

Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry

Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Manager, Corporate Development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development

Easy Payroll Global Limited Ireland and their local affiliate ITOS Brasil LTDA is looking to hire a Manager, Corporate Development, to provide services to companies within the Perseus Group (“Perseus”).

Perseus is an Operating Group of Constellation Software Inc. (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, and located in over 40 offices.

Location: Brazil

The Role:

The services to be provided by the Manager, Corporate Development, encompasses building strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. These relationships will be formed with software company decision makers (e.g. CEOs, VPs of Corporate Development, founders, and/or owners) of software companies, M&A advisors, and private equity/ venture capital professionals. Success in this role is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships that ultimately lead to Perseus’ acquisition of software companies.

The process of initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately making an acquisition typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/ relationships, and high-quality market research are what ultimately generate successful acquisitions through time.

Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s).
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency.
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals.
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.

Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • At least 3+ years of experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role, or prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.

Other Requirements:

  • This role will require occasional in-person travel, which may include Canada, the U.S., Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and/or Peru, and can be primarily performed remotely.

title: Sales Operations & Data Analyst
description:

Qualificações Básicas

• Proatividade e atitude positiva: busca informações de forma independente, resolve problemas conceituais, mobiliza recursos e entrega resultados em situações desafiadoras e multifacetadas; motivado(a) e engajado(a) para colaborar em um ambiente dinâmico e em constante mudança

title: Data Engineer
description:
About the Role

We are seeking an Intermediate Data Engineer to support our data infrastructure initiatives by connecting analytics systems, managing data pipelines, and enabling our teams with clean, accessible data. This role will focus on integrating key data sources, developing efficient pipelines, and ensuring seamless data flow across platforms like Google Analytics , BigQuery , and Databricks .

Key Responsibilities

  • Data Integration:
  • Integrate Google Analytics with BigQuery to centralize and structure web analytics data.
  • Establish and optimize the connection between BigQuery and cloud Databricks environments for downstream analytics and modeling.

Pipeline Development:

  • Design, build, and maintain data pipelines within Databricks to support the sandbox team and analytical workloads.
  • Ensure pipelines are reliable, scalable, and adhere to best practices for data quality and performance.

Collaboration & Support:

  • Partner with data analysts, engineers, and product teams to understand data needs and translate them into efficient engineering solutions.
  • Assist in implementing version control, CI/CD processes, and monitoring for data workflows.

Requirements

  • 2–4 years of experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar data infrastructure role.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and experience with BigQuery .
  • Hands-on experience working with Databricks (or similar cloud-based data platforms).
  • Understanding of data pipeline orchestration , ETL processes , and data modeling concepts.
  • Familiarity with Google Analytics data export and schema.
  • Experience with Python , PySpark , or other data engineering languages is a plus.

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to cloud environments (GCP, AWS, or Azure).
  • Experience with Airflow , DBT , or other orchestration tools.
  • Knowledge of data governance and data security best practices.

Why Join Us

  • Be part of a growing data ecosystem that directly drives business insights.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams across engineering, analytics, and product.
  • Opportunity to work on modern cloud infrastructure and cutting-edge data tools.

title: Software Engineer Sênior - Vaga afirmativa para pessoas LGBTQIAPN+
description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.
Quem nós somos

Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact ! Quais serão suas atividades; Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.
Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe. Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando JavaScript/TypeScript e frameworks modernos como React e Next.js , priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance. 
  • Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB) , com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.
  • Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem , configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS.
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar : transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.
  • Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD , testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.
  • Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.


O que nós estamos procurando;

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.
  • Experiência solida (+5 anos):  em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, JavaScript e TypeScript.  
  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
  • Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD , uso de Docker , Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
  • Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.
  • Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).


O que oferecemos;

  • VR/VT
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
  • Gympass
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender
  • Cultura: junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!

Junte-se a nós!

title: Store Manager - Garten Mall Joinville
description:
Seja quem você é. Ame o que faz.

Estamos em busca de pessoas que querem mais do que um emprego . Levamos a sério nossas pessoas, nossos clientes e o planeta , e queremos fazer o bem juntos .

Nova loja em Joinville - Garten Shopping

COTTON ON GROUP — NOSSA CULTURA

Somos um time diverso com mais de 20 mil pessoas ao redor do mundo que adoram pensar grande e se divertir no processo . Desenvolvemos, reconhecemos e recompensamos nossos times para que se sintam empoderados a atingir todo o seu potencial.

Sabemos que a vida é mais divertida quando você pode ser você mesmo — e aqui, você é celebrado por ser autêntico .

Você é o que torna o Cotton On o varejista global único que somos hoje.

Cotton On

A Cotton On nasceu em 1991 e foi a marca fundadora do Cotton On Group .

Hoje, temos quase 800 lojas em todo o mundo , e seguimos encantando nossos clientes com moda acessível e atual , em roupas femininas, masculinas e acessórios .

Nossa marca existe para oferecer básicos cheios de estilo , com moda rápida e divertida — e tudo isso sem perder a leveza e a diversão no caminho.

MAIS DO QUE UM EMPREGO

Não somos de falar — somos de agir .

Cerca de 80% das nossas posições globais são preenchidas por promoções internas , porque acreditamos que ser você mesmo pode te levar longe no Cotton On.

Estamos empolgados em compartilhar esta oportunidade e em dar boas-vindas a um novo integrante para fortalecer nossa cultura e propósito de fazer a diferença positiva na vida das pessoas .

Nossas equipes de loja são as responsáveis por fazer com que os clientes vivenciem a diferença de uma loja Cotton On — aqui, todos são bem-vindos e valorizados .

Você será o porta-voz da nossa Foundation , mostrando como nossos times e clientes geram impacto real em projetos ao redor do mundo .

Com seu olhar comercial, você identifica oportunidades de vendas , apoia sua equipe para atingir resultados e se orgulha de promover o crescimento interno .

Você exerce autonomia e discernimento ao desenvolver e comunicar estratégias que garantam uma experiência incrível ao cliente , ao mesmo tempo em que impulsionam as vendas e o crescimento da loja.

Como Gerente de Loja , você é responsável por liderar todos os aspectos do negócio , promovendo uma cultura positiva e inclusiva , desenvolvendo e inspirando sua equipe para alcançar metas de vendas e indicadores (KPI’s) , além de garantir o crescimento sustentável da loja , alinhado aos valores e políticas da empresa.

Habilidades e Experiência

  • Paixão por produto, marcas, moda e tendências
  • Experiência em Gestão de Varejo , preferencialmente em fast fashion
  • Experiência comprovada liderando e inspirando equipes diversas e de alta performance
  • Capacidade analítica para interpretar e impulsionar resultados de vendas, estoque e atendimento
  • Conhecimento em Visual Merchandising , garantindo a execução impecável das diretrizes de VM
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, atendimento ao cliente e resolução de problemas
  • Capacidade de atuar em um ambiente dinâmico.

Benefícios

  • 50% de desconto em todos os produtos e marcas do grupo
  • Apoio de bem-estar 24h por dia / 7 dias por semana
  • Bônus de meta batida
  • Vale Refeição + Vale Alimentação
  • Benefícios para você – plano médico & odontológico, totalpass
  • Oportunidades de desenvolvimento que podem te levar a qualquer lugar
  • Prêmios trimestrais COG + reconhecimento em tempo real
  • Descontos em cursos do SENAC
  • Seguro de Vida
  • 50% off em curso de inglês (até R$400/mês)

Fazer o Bem Importa

Fazer uma diferença positiva na vida das pessoas é o nosso propósito.

É o que nos motiva todos os dias (quase como um café bem forte ☕).

Não é apenas como fazemos negócios , é quem somos .

The Good é o nosso movimento para gerar mudanças significativas e focar no que realmente importa — pessoas e planeta .

Celebramos as diferenças e fortalecemos conexões, porque somos mais fortes juntos .

Nossa Foundation está no coração de tudo isso — e juntos, já arrecadamos mais de 120 milhões de dólares para projetos transformadores ao redor do mundo , graças às nossas equipes e clientes .

Fazer parte do nosso time é mais do que um trabalho .

Como dizemos aqui no Cotton On Group :

Seja você mesmo — isso muda o mundo.

Venha fazer parte da nossa marca australiana e deixe sua marca também.

Candidate-se hoje mesmo!

title: Data Architect
description:
About the Product:

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.

Job Purpose:

The Data Architect will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining robust data models and SQL-based solutions, with a focus on Google Cloud Platform. This role will ensure data integrity, optimize database performance, and support data-driven initiatives, particularly within the higher education sector.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Data Modelling and SQL Development

  • Design and implement scalable and efficient relational and dimensional data models.
  • Develop, optimize, and maintain complex SQL queries, stored procedures, and functions.
  • Ensure data quality and integrity across various data sources and reporting layers.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand data requirements and translate them into technical specifications.

Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Expertise

  • Utilize GCP services such as BigQuery, Cloud SQL, and Dataflow for data storage, processing, and analysis.
  • Implement and manage cloud-based data warehouses and data lakes on GCP.
  • Develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code solutions for GCP data environments using tools like Terraform.
  • Monitor and optimize GCP resource performance and cost for data platforms.

Collaboration and Communication

  • Serve as a primary liaison among business leads, product managers, and data/engineering teams.
  • Facilitate demos, knowledge-sharing sessions, and best-practice documentation for data solutions.
  • Promote adoption of new data capabilities and practices; gather feedback for continuous improvement.

Release and Change Management

  • Coordinate release plans, timelines, and stakeholder readiness for data model and SQL deployments.
  • Ensure training, job aids, and rollout communications are prepared and delivered for data solutions.
  • Track post-release issues, adoption, and stabilization metrics related to data platforms.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • Ability to produce and manage, work autonomously, and take initiative.
  • “Can-do” attitude with unwavering ethics and a willingness to help others.
  • Exceptional relationship-building skills, cultural competency, and ability to communicate effectively with diverse groups of people and roles.
  • Willingness to embrace relational nuances, own personal mistakes, be empathetic, address conflicts directly and transparently, and commit to self-reflection and self-betterment.
  • Dexterity to effectively deal with ambiguity, change, and continuous process improvements.
  • Strong business analysis fundamentals: elicitation, documentation, process mapping, traceability, UAT.

Requirements:

  • Strong proficiency in SQL and experience with relational database design and data modelling.
  • Demonstrable experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) data services (e.g., BigQuery, Cloud SQL, Dataflow).
  • Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code solutions, e.g., Terraform.
  • Experience with data quality checks and data governance best practices.
  • Experience with Git and Git providers, e.g., GitHub/BitBucket/GitLab.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience in the higher education space.
  • Experience with data orchestration frameworks, e.g., Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, dbt.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools for data platforms.
  • Familiarity with Python for data scripting and automation.

Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent life/work experience.
  • 5+ years in SQL engineering, data modelling, data engineering, or a related data-centric role, preferably within SaaS, marketing technology, higher ed tech, or related domains.

We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

title: ESPECIALISTA DE PROCESSOS COMERCIAL
description:
Descrição da vaga

Somos o grupo educacional mais diversificado do país. Todos os dias, criamos futuros incríveis através da inovação. Colocamos a mão na massa para tirar as ideias do papel e colocá-las em prática. Enfrentamos desafios com resiliência e nos adaptamos às mudanças constantes.

Por aqui, somos um time e não heróis, guiados pela vontade de fazer a diferença e conectados de um só jeito, o #JeitoCogna. Nossa relação é direta e respeitosa, e o sucesso dos nossos alunos e clientes é o nosso sucesso.

Além disso, valorizamos a diversidade, porque sabemos que quanto mais diverso é o nosso repertório, mais abrangente e inclusivo seremos. Juntos impulsionamos as pessoas a construírem uma melhor versão de si! E aí, bora fazer parte da empresa líder absoluta do segmento educacional? Vem pra Cogna.

Como será seu dia a dia:

Buscamos uma Pessoa Especialista de Processos com viés de projetos e melhoria contínua, que tenha energia, visão sistêmica e vontade de construir!

Essa pessoa será responsável por mergulhar na jornada dos produtores, mapear oportunidades de melhoria, e liderar projetos estruturantes que aprimorem a eficiência e a experiência da operação comercial. Será o elo entre área de negócio, TI e Produto, garantindo que as demandas e melhorias saiam do papel — desde o desenho do processo até a implementação das soluções.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

• Mapear, desenhar e otimizar processos críticos da operação (mão na massa!).

• Liderar projetos estruturantes voltados à melhoria da jornada do produtor e da operação de vendas.

• Realizar análises de dados e indicadores para identificar oportunidades de melhoria contínua.

• Promover a integração entre áreas de negócio, TI e Produto, garantindo entregas eficientes.

• Atuar próximo ao time comercial e de suporte à venda, com presença in loco quando necessário.

• Promover comunicação eficaz entre as equipes envolvidas.

• Apoiar a capacitação do time em boas práticas de processos e projetos.

• Elaborar reports semanais sobre andamento dos projetos e entregas.

title: Sales Analyst
description:
At Blueground , our vision is to make people feel at home wherever they choose to live. For us, that means ensuring our guests have the peace of mind, flexibility & confidence they need to explore life’s latest adventure.

We’ve grown a lot since our founding in 2013, having raised more than $258m+ in funding, to date -- and that’s just the beginning. We’re now hosting guests in more than 15,000 homes in 32 cities around the world (and growing!), with an aim to hit 100,000 homes in 100 cities by 2025.

Our vision comes to life through our ways of working. For our 1,000+ member team located across 17 countries, we’ve created a culture of collaboration, inclusiveness, and opportunity.

We believe our people should have the power to choose their preferred way to work. Depending on the role’s requirements, team members can choose to work full time in one of our offices, work fully remote, or choose a hybrid model between the two.

We are driven by our core values. To our team, Time is our most important resource. Excellence isn’t simply a standard, but an exciting way to look at life. We Care deeply about our guests and colleagues. Our relationships are built around Transparency , which builds trust and improves communication.

We are looking to recruit a Sales Analyst based in São Paulo to join our B2C Inbound Sales department. As member of our sales team you will manage inbound sales requests concerning bookings of Tabas properties .

RESPONSIBILITIES AND ATTRIBUTIONS

  • Respond to incoming property sales inquiries full cycle and handling requests (via phone, email, whatsapp, etc) generated from all online sales channels (Website, Airbnb, Vivareal, Zap, Corporate Housing Partners, Corporates) offering clients the best accommodation solution based on their need;
  • Support the entire sales process to ensure delivery against key performance metrics;
  • Interact and negotiate with clients, help them to understand the business, and solve any queries they might have;
  • Proactive daily pipeline management in our CRM.

REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • Nice to have experience in sales or account management ;
  • Ability to run proper exploratory/discovery calls, be an active listener and objection handling and negotiation;
  • Flexibility to work on weekends and holidays;
  • Ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment;
  • Customer-first mindset and hunter mentality;
  • A coachable individual able to implement feedback;
  • Advanced in English, ability to talk and write with normality.

INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

  • Meal/Food voucher on the Flex Flash card of R$40.00 per day (no payroll discount);
  • Transportation voucher based on your route to the office (with 3% discount on payroll);
  • Our Health Care is Amil (with co-participation);
  • Our Dental Plan is Amil (without co-participation);
  • Daycare allowance for employees with children up to 5 years old;
  • For your Physical Health, we have TotalPass, our gym benefit;
  • For your Emotional Health, we have the Moodar platform;
  • Partnership with Cambly for an English course;
  • Flexible Holidays (from 6 months onwards you are entitled to proportional holidays);
  • 25% discount when using Tabas apartments;
  • Once a month we have a celebration the Tabers Birthday's;
  • Birthday Day Off + giftcard paid on the Flash card, to make your day even special;
  • Our workplace has a cinema room, spaces for decompression and an equipped kitchen;
  • In the condominium we have a Bike rack, Full Kitchen and Lunch Room.

Buscamos um(a) Especialista em Performance Web Front-End apaixonado(a) por otimizar a velocidade, a responsividade e a experiência do usuário das nossas aplicações web. O foco principal é garantir o carregamento ultrarrápido das páginas, melhorar as métricas de Core Web Vitals e aplicar as melhores práticas de SEO Técnico, resultando em melhor posicionamento nos mecanismos de busca e aumento nas taxas de conversão.

Principais Responsabilidades

1. Otimização de Performance:

- Analisar, diagnosticar e solucionar gargalos de performance no Front-End (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, imagens, fontes).

- Focar na melhoria contínua das métricas Core Web Vitals (LCP, FID/INP, CLS) e outras métricas de velocidade (TTFB, FCP, TTI).

- Implementar técnicas de otimização como code splitting, lazy loading, pré-carregamento de recursos (preloading/prefetching), compressão (Gzip/Brotli) e caching avançado.

2. SEO Técnico e Carregamento:

- Garantir a rastreabilidade (crawlability) e indexação eficiente das páginas por bots de mecanismos de busca.

- Otimizar a estrutura do DOM, o uso de HTML semântico e metatags.

- Trabalhar na renderização ideal (server-side, client-side ou híbrida/SSR) para equilibrar performance e SEO.

3. Monitoramento e Análise:

-Utilizar ferramentas como Google PageSpeed Insights, Lighthouse, WebPageTest, Google Search Console e ferramentas de RUM (Real User Monitoring) para monitorar e reportar a performance em ambientes de produção.

-Criar e manter dashboards de performance, identificando tendências e oportunidades de otimização.

4. Colaboração e Educação:

-Colaborar de perto com equipes de Design (UX/UI), Back-End e Marketing/SEO para garantir que as novas funcionalidades sejam lançadas com alta performance e aderência técnica.

-Definir padrões de desenvolvimento e atuar como um mentor técnico, disseminando a cultura de performance para toda a equipe de Front-End.

Requisitos Técnicos Essenciais (Hard Skills)

• Proficiência em: HTML semântico, CSS (incluindo pré-processadores ou CSS-in-JS) e JavaScript moderno (ES6+).

• Domínio de Frameworks/Bibliotecas: Experiência avançada em pelo menos um dos principais frameworks de Front-End (React, Vue.js ou Angular), com foco na otimização de builds e carregamento.

• Otimização de Assets: Conhecimento profundo em otimização de imagens (WebP, AVIF, tag), font loading (FOIT, FOUT) e minificação de código.

• Ferramentas de Build/Bundling: Experiência com ferramentas como Webpack, Rollup ou Vite, configurando otimizações para produção.

• Infraestrutura/Rede: Entendimento de redes ( Content Delivery Networks (CDN) e estratégias de cache no navegador e no servidor.

• SEO Técnico: Conhecimento em Sitemap, Robots.txt, canonicalização, dados estruturados (Schema.org) e experiências de usuário mobile.

Habilidades Comportamentais (Soft Skills)

• Foco em Resultados: Orientação clara para melhorias mensuráveis (KPIs) de performance e SEO.

• Resolução de Problemas Complexos: Capacidade de diagnosticar problemas que atravessam múltiplas camadas (navegador, rede, servidor, código).

• Comunicação: Habilidade para explicar problemas técnicos complexos e as soluções propostas para audiências não técnicas (marketing, gestão).

• Aprendizado Contínuo: Manter-se atualizado com as constantes mudanças nos algoritmos de busca e nas tecnologias de otimização web.

Diferenciais

• Experiência com SSR (Server-Side Rendering) ou SSG (Static Site Generation) usando frameworks como Next.js ou Nuxt.js.

• Conhecimento de PWA (Progressive Web Apps) e estratégias offline-first.

Experiência em plataformas de Cloud Computing (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure) para otimizar o deployment e a entrega.

title: Auxiliar Administrativo (PCD)
description:
Sobre a vaga

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então inscreva-se nesta oportunidade!

Esta vaga é exclusiva para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD) com atuação na área de Gestão de Pessoas da unidade de Jaguariaíva .

Nosso objetivo é identificar e atrair profissionais cujos valores e competências estejam alinhados com a cultura da Arauco . Você será considerado para futuras oportunidades compatíveis com seu perfil.

Importante: Ao se cadastrar, anexe um único arquivo com seu currículo e laudo ou exame comprobatórios atualizados.

title: Lead Technical Consultant
description:
Company Overview

At Synamedia, we’re a global team of 1,700+ trailblazers across 20 countries, revolutionizing how the world is entertained and informed. With a legacy of protecting our long-time customers, we’re laser-focused on driving growth and leading the charge as the industry shifts from Pay-TV to IP and streaming. We are the pioneers in next-gen media cloud services who power the viewing experiences of billions of people on Earth with our best-in-class live streaming, distribution, ad tech, cloud platforms, and more.

Our solutions, built over three decades and trusted by 1,000+ customers, fuel giants like Disney, NBA, The Olympics, Astro, Comcast, Tata Play, and many more.

Ready to grow with us and shape the future of media and entertainment solutions? Let’s do it together!

About the Job – Lead Technical Consultant

Key Responsibilities:

  • Ensuring a healthy platform delivering smooth services for all the customers.
  • Provide strong technical leadership to ensure continuous improvement across the team
  • Prime contributor for automation and scripting tasks.
  • Must have worked in a fast-paced, quick response/crisis handling team.
  • In-depth knowledge and experience of supporting complex projects.
  • Command and control during High Priority Events.
  • Responsible for contribution in refining Service Centre tools and processes.
  • Implement monitoring scripts to prevent repetitive issues.
  • Able to work independently or as part of a team towards complex issue resolutions.
  • Ability to collaborate with customer deployment teams.
  • Solid communicator, with excellent written and spoken Portuguese and English.
  • Must know ITIL framework (Incident, Change, Problem, configuration)
  • Independently/collectively troubleshoot issues reported by customer on ServiceNow ticketing tool.
  • Accurate analysis, tracking and reporting of any problems or issues found during investigation.
  • Contribute to the knowledge management in the department.
  • Collaboration with the support and deployment teams to resolve issues. Good with documentation and RCA preparation.
  • Development of training material, for education and knowledge sharing with other team members as appropriate.
  • A good understanding how to monitor and improve service quality.
  • Stay on top of customer reported issues, regularly communicate with customers.

Technical Skills:

  • Excellent in problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Excellent Linux Systems Administrator.
  • Good experience with at least one scripting language (bash, python, perl).
  • Experience in support and configuration of software applications on both Linux and Windows operating systems.
  • Knowledge of applications clusters for application redundancy desirable ,e.g., Red Hat Cluster.
  • Experience with operation and support of virtual machines using VMware (vSphere and vCenter) would be advantageous
  • Experience with a video delivery system, preferably in a support or integration role.
  • Solid with relational database (Oracle preferred) and non-relational database (Mongo preferred). Good understanding of networking, TCP/IP and UDP protocols
  • Good understanding of network transfer protocols FTP.
  • Proven SQL scripting skills.
  • Strong in automation and process improvement.
  • Experience in digital video delivering systems with in-depth knowledge in at least one of the following technologies: Conditional Access, DRM, OTT, STB, Encryption, Decryption.
  • Knowledge of MPEG/DVB or other video delivery technologies.
  • Awareness of STB software and hardware.
  • Ability to understand data represented in XML or JSON.
  • Good to have knowledge of Media products.
  • Aware of multimedia concepts in Mpeg2, H.264, TS, OTT, IPTV, HD & SD resolutions, 4K TV, DRM, VOD, Live streaming, PPV, Adaptive Streaming
  • Team handling experience would be a Plus.

Qualifications, Experience and Personnal skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree/BCA/ B. Tech or equivalent.
  • Ideally 8 years of experience in a relevant support, integration, or deployment role.
  • Ability to work within a multi-tasking dynamic environment and cope with changing priorities
  • Quick learner
  • Proactive
  • Customer focused
  • Experience dealing with global customers.
  • Ability to work individually or as part of a team
  • Strong communicator at management and technical levels
  • Self-motivated and self-sufficient

Growth Opportunities

When welcoming new talent into the team, we are always looking for opportunities to bring in new ideas, those who ask challenging questions and have the curiosity to learn. These qualities are important to us as we nurture a culture of innovation, seize more opportunities to partner with our customers and make a difference as we transform the future of video. To further support your growth and that of our talent pool, Synamedia offers an exhaustive library of skill enhancement resources from AWS, SkillSoft and other partners to help you upskill while on the job. Be it data analytics that piques your brain or content creation, there’s something for every kind of mind.

Benefits and Perks

  • Flexible working arrangements.
  • Competitive pay hikes and bonus packages.
  • Skill enhancement and growth opportunities.
  • Equal opportunity employment.
  • Health and wellbeing programmes.
  • Collaborative work with a truly global team.

A Culture of Belonging

Synamedia is committed to promoting a diverse, inclusive and equal opportunity community - a place where we can all be ourselves and succeed. Our values connect us, and we love to win together. We work with a bias to action, have a bold approach and encourage being deeply curious to grow and evolve, as a team.

In our aim to foster a people-friendly environment, we offer a range of family friendly, inclusive employment policies, flexible working arrangements, engagement activities and services to support all our colleagues across our 20 office locations. Synamedia regularly organises community events that promote cohesion and diversity among colleagues. We are proud of our mental health wellbeing initiatives, our Pride month awareness campaign, our cancer awareness programme and much more.

More information

If this role sparks your interest or any questions, or if you require any accommodations to be made to help you through your application, please reach out to our recruitment team, who would be happy to help.

title: Architect
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking an Architecture Lead to drive the design and execution of brand experiences, pop-ups, permanent retail spaces, and large-scale installations. This role merges creative vision with technical expertise, bridging design, production, and fabrication to deliver exceptional innovative environments. You'll lead projects from concept through construction, providing strategic direction, coordinating cross-disciplinary teams, and serving as the key liaison between creative leadership, production, and fabrication partners.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead multiple projects simultaneously
  • Drive design development from initial concept through detailed construction documentation
  • Establish and maintain design standards, ensuring high-quality, innovative, and functional outcomes
  • Collaborate with producers and project managers to maintain project timelines, milestones, and deliverables
  • Partner with creative directors to understand design intent and translate it into clear architectural strategies
  • Generate daily creative briefs to guide the architecture design team on project direction and next steps
  • Provide real-time feedback, guidance, and mentorship to junior architectural designers throughout the design process
  • Communicate and present complex design ideas clearly to both creative and technical stakeholders
  • Develop precise schematic drawing packages and 3D models in Rhinoceros for vendor and fabricator coordination
  • Ensure all drawings and designs comply with relevant codes, standards, and regulations for domestic and international markets
  • Collaborate directly with engineers, fabricators, and contractors to identify optimal solutions for project execution
  • Review and approve shop drawings and fabrication details prior to production
  • Research, review, and specify appropriate materials and finishes
  • Provide construction oversight to ensure design intent is maintained throughout on-site execution

REQUIREMENTS

  • Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Architecture
  • 8+ years of professional experience in architecture, with proven leadership in design-driven projects
  • Experience with retail, set design, exhibitions, or experiential installations
  • Strong understanding of materials, construction methods, and fabrication processes
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy in creating technical drawings and specifications
  • Excellent leadership, organizational, and communication skills
  • Portfolio demonstrating design excellence and ability to work on projects at different scales
  • Ability to manage fast-paced projects and adapt quickly to shifting priorities
  • Ability to work effectively independently and as part of a team
  • Professional knowledge and use of Rhinoceros is mandatory
  • Proficient in Google Docs suite (Docs, Slides, Spreadsheet)
  • Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign)
  • Ability to quickly learn Cinema 4D and Octane rendering software

ABOUT DE-YAN

DE-YAN is a brand experience studio built to lead the next era of human connection.

We seamlessly fuse creative development, in-house production, and immersive storytelling to create authentic, human-first moments – moments that are proven to build a powerful relationship between brands and their audiences.

With deep roots in fashion, luxury, beauty, and lifestyle, DE-YAN balances concept and craft to create innovative, experience-led creative across five key disciplines: Experiential Design, Motion, Creative Technology, Graphic Design, and Physical Production - all rooted in Creative Strategy and a deep understanding of culture. Our global team of 120+ full-time creatives spans New York, Los Angeles, EU, Brazil, and Canada, allowing us to bring diverse perspectives and rigorous precision to every brief.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Venha para uma das maiores empresas de serviços de TI do mundo!! Aqui você pode transformar sua carreira!Por que se juntar à TCS? Aqui na TCS acreditamos que as pessoas fazem a diferença, por isso vivemos uma cultura de aprendizado ilimitado, cheia de oportunidades de melhoria e desenvolvimento mútuo. O cenário ideal para expandir ideias por meio das ferramentas certas, contribuindo para o nosso sucesso em um ambiente colaborativo.

Estamos procurando um engenheiro de dados sênior que queira aprender e transformar sua carreira.

Título da vaga :

Engenheiro de Dados Sênior – GCP

Resumo da Posição :

Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior especializado(a) em Google Cloud Platform para projetar, implementar e otimizar pipelines de dados escaláveis e robustos. Você será responsável por arquitetar soluções que suportem grandes volumes de dados, garantindo segurança, qualidade e disponibilidade das informações para análise e tomada de decisão.

A Engenharia de Dados é responsável por desenvolver, implementar e manter o Pipeline de Dados. Este Pipeline contempla todas as etapas relacionadas ao fluxo de dados, desde a extração, passando pelo armazenamento, até a distribuição dos dados para consumo. O que inclui a capacidade de:

• projetar,

• criar,

• implantar,

• monitorar,

• manter e

• proteger

• cargas de trabalho de processamento de dados.

Responsabilidades :

Projetar e implementar arquiteturas de dados na GCP utilizando serviços como BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, Composer, entre outros.

Desenvolver e otimizar pipelines ETL/ELT escaláveis e de alta performance.

Garantir a qualidade, integridade e segurança dos dados de ponta a ponta.

Criar e manter modelos de dados alinhados com as necessidades de negócio.

Atuar em conjunto com cientistas de dados, analistas e engenheiros de software para suportar casos de uso de análise avançada e machine learning.

Automatizar processos de ingestão, transformação e disponibilização de dados.

Monitorar e otimizar custo e desempenho dos recursos na GCP.

Implementar boas práticas de DataOps e Governança de Dados.

Requisitos Técnicos :

Experiência de 5 anos, sendo pelo menos 2 com GCP.

Conhecimento das camadas do datalake.

Domínio de BigQuery, Dataflow (Apache Beam), Cloud Storage e Pub/Sub.

Experiência com Python, SQL e preferencialmente Java/Scala.

Conhecimento de orquestração com Cloud Composer (Airflow).

Experiência com modelagem de dados (relacional, dimensional e NoSQL).

Conhecimento em processamento batch e streaming.

Experiência com otimização de custo e performance na nuvem.

Vivência com CI/CD aplicado a pipelines de dados (Git, Cloud Build, Terraform).

Diferenciais :

Certificações GCP (ex.: Professional Data Engineer, Cloud Architect).

Conhecimento em Kubernetes (GKE) e APIs na GCP.

Experiência com BigQuery, Dataflow, Vertex AI, SaaS, APIGee (foco em GCP).

Experiência em Machine Learning pipelines (Vertex AI, AI Platform).

Atuação prévia com Data Mesh e arquiteturas distribuídas.

title: Sales Consultant
description:
About Us

Established 20 years ago, Phi Partners is a global technology services consultancy based out of London with an annualized turnover of £50m.

We operate exclusively within capital markets, in the front office, pricing and risk space, covering both business and technology services. With six lines of business, four international hubs and five international delivery centres, Phi has become a leading global financial markets IT services provider within our niche domains. We have over 500 consultants supporting more than 80 financial institutions around the world.

Our international sales team run out of Wrotham Business Park in London where we have over 30 sales consultants covering the broad range of business lines, clients and geographies. This team includes junior sales personnel who focus primarily on candidate research and recruitment whilst they are being trained to become client-facing sales consultants and eventually account managers. We are now expanding out Sales & Research team to include a team in our São Paulo office!

Phi offers our clients a comprehensive range of services including staff augmentation, advisory, project and managed services. These deals range from £100,000 to £20,000,000 in size, creating huge revenue and earnings opportunities.

Role and Career Opportunities

Phi has an ongoing commitment to growth in terms of client acquisition, geographical reach, and evolution of our lines of business and service catalogue. To support our ambitions, we take on four cohorts of junior sales consultants each year, in January, April, July, and October. Each consultant is trained the “Phi way”.

We are looking for talent who are either fresh out of university or in the early stages of their careers. Subject to meeting reasonable competency and performance targets, you can expect regular opportunities for advancement throughout your journey:

  • In the first 6 months you will be in our London Office being trained by our leadership team.
  • Initially, you will focus on candidate research and recruitment. After six months, you will be allocated to a line of business, allowing you to become a specialist recruiter within that field. Training that is specific to the line of business will allow you to master your ability to converse confidently with client and internal specialists.
  • After a period of between 12-18 months, you can expect to begin your move into client-facing sales. You will be allocated a small number of clients specific to your line of business, beginning your journey with client research, leading into full client engagement if the client is approved as a target.
  • Once you have closed deals with clients (bringing master services agreements between the client and Phi), you will begin to generate P&L. Subject to competency and revenue targets, you will complete your move into sales. We expect this phase to take between 18-24 months, and you will be supported on your journey by more senior sales leads, a deal architecture / pre-sales team, and the subject-matter-experts from within the delivery teams.
  • As a fully-fledged sales consultant, you will be part of a smaller group of 10, that are some of the best in the world. You will manage your client portfolio and may be given an expanded scope of clients giving you the room to really become a true success. Depending on results, you may be allocated one or two strategic key accounts, with the greatest potential for growth. These accounts are global, and relevant for multiple lines of business. They will bring a large portfolio, driving significant P&L and earnings.

Our most successful salespeople will make Partner at Phi, giving access to stock in the company that is granted annually based on a transparent assessment of contribution. Within the sales team we have three partners today, all of whom came through the graduate program, and we except two more to get promoted in 2025. The sky is the limit at Phi for the most ambitions and driven!

What we are looking for

Commitment and drive

We are looking for highly motivated individuals with a strong desire to succeed, and who are prepared to do “whatever it takes”. We are looking for problem solvers who have the ability to “find a way” to solve any challenge; people who won’t give up when the going gets tough! To become successful, it will take a long time to develop the required skills to be independent and to operate autonomously. So, we are looking for people who are truly committed and driven. These are all skills that you will have had life-long, applied and improved over many years. We will be looking to understand what drives you at a fundamental level, as this is what you will rely on to succeed.

Communication and charisma

Our sales consultants must be great communicators: people who have natural confidence with person-to-person communication, from over-the-phone interactions to directing meetings with senior stakeholders. You will need to be charismatic and confident. An ability to develop meaningful and relationships built on respect and trust is critical.

Team spirit

At Phi we have maintained a “small company” mindset and feel, with an excellent team spirit – we work together, we socialize together, we support each other. Our appreciation for the wider Phi community makes us stronger than the sum of our parts. We are looking for people who will naturally be at home as part of a strong team – who can understand our values, contribute to the wider Phi community, share knowledge, and put the team before themselves. We will be looking for evidence of this, academically, professionally, or outside (such as sport).

Life at Phi

Phi is an established business but feels like a start-up, specially being part of our brand-new team in Brazil. Your base will be in São Paulo, but as you develop into client-facing sales, you will spend time out of the office and will have opportunities for regular international travel.

Our family mentality means that even the most junior at Phi has access to the senior leadership team. We are approachable. You will be on first name terms with the CRO and CEO. Beyond the sales team, you will work within a wider community across pre-sales and delivery, specific to your clients and your line-of-business.

Our company thrives in having a diverse and international staff and this is especially true in our London office, where the Sales & Research team is located. Our sales consultants come from all parts of the world and there is a vibrant and youthful atmosphere. The atmosphere is dynamic and busy (punctual starts and hard work are inevitable), but always friendly. We socialize regularly outside office hours. Many of the senior team members at Phi have known each other for decades, and people who are the right fit for Phi can expect to build friendships that will last a lifetime. The goal is to build a similar environment in our new operation in Brazil!

Training and Reward

You can expect initial and ongoing training, in a well-designed, competency-based framework with a comprehensive and growing learning and development library. You can expect to be carefully performance-managed using our proprietary tools, ensuring that your contributions are fairly measured and that you are supported in your drive to succeed in any areas that need developing.

We offer competitive salaries and the best commission structure in the market. We have a simple and straightforward commission model that rewards you for what you generate. With no caps, your earning potential is unlimited.

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Software Back-End - Sênior (Data Platform)
description:
#Nosso jeito de fazer história

Entre para a história de construção do maior Hub de Dados e Analytics do Brasil.

Além de você contribuir diretamente neste objetivo, você estará se desenvolvendo constantemente, por meio de grandes desafios de negócio, junto a um time de alto impacto. Na Neoway, acreditamos em fazer as coisas de forma inovadora, colaborativa, responsável e com foco no cliente.

Falando da área: Trabalhar na área de Engenharia da Neoway mantém o colaborador conectado com a inovação, ao constante aprimoramento por melhores metodologias de desenvolvimento e a novas tecnologias para atender os objetivos estratégicos e de negócios da Neoway.

Utilizamos metodologias ágeis por princípio e focamos no ciclo de desenvolvimento de produto para oferecer a melhor experiência aos nossos usuários. O time de Engenharia é responsável por construir, evoluir e sustentar todo o ecossistema que compõem nossa plataforma de Big Data Analytics, chamada Plataforma Neoway.

Acreditamos que um software de qualidade é fácil de usar, funciona corretamente, é de fácil manutenção/sustentação, fácil integração e mantém a integridade para evitar possíveis falhas, fora ou não, do controle de quem o desenvolveu.

Para alcançar este objetivo atuamos em dois pilares distintos para garantir a eficiência do processo de desenvolvimento de software assegurando a qualidade junto a um ambiente saudável na área de Engenharia, no aspecto de boas práticas e cultura de desenvolvimento:

  • 1° - Pessoas é um pilar estratégico para Neoway, atuamos de maneira pró ativa em conjunto com todas as áreas da empresa, garantindo o desenvolvimento de talentos, crescimento profissional e formação do nosso DNA, impulsionando a cultura de times de alta performance (liberdade com responsabilidade).
  • 2° - Técnico (Paved Way), acreditamos que ferramental e a automação ajudam a dimensionar a capacidade de um time, mas nenhuma ferramenta resolverá todos os problemas na produtividade no desenvolvimento ou nas operações. A ideia é ter um conjunto de ferramentas e práticas de “paved way” que são formalmente suportadas por algumas pessoas. Não exigimos a adoção desses “paved way” , mas incentivamos a adoção, garantindo que o desenvolvimento e as operações usando essas tecnologias sejam uma experiência muito melhor do que não usá-las.

Falando do time: O foco do time de Data Platform é impulsionar a estratégia de Plataforma de Dados e Big Data na Neoway, fornecendo ferramentas, estabelecendo padrões e oferecendo suporte para que os times de dados possam acelerar o desenvolvimento de produtos, aumentando a celeridade e a autonomia desses times.

#Missão do cargo

Como Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Software no time de Data Platform, você será responsável por criar ferramentas e soluções para as pessoas engenheiras de dados da empresa, atuando desde a concepção até o lançamento em produção de soluções de coleta e integração de dados. Seu objetivo será simplificar e abstrair a plataforma, tornando-a mais eficiente e fácil de usar. Suas responsabilidades incluirão evoluir nosso motor de ingestão de dados, desenvolver protótipos para provas de conceito, manter nossa plataforma de dados na cloud (GCP) e realizar o troubleshooting da plataforma com métricas customizadas. Em um ambiente inovador e colaborativo, você agregará conhecimento técnico ao time, sustentando, evoluindo e construindo soluções para nossa plataforma, garantindo a segurança, qualidade do código e arquitetura, visando um trabalho harmônico em equipe.

Responsabilidades:

  • Trabalhar na concepção de soluções técnicas, na quebra de tarefas, planejamento e na execução das demandas;
  • Garantir a qualidade das entregas através da participação ativa em Code Reviews e do desenvolvimento de testes unitários e de integração;
  • Manter, monitorar e garantir a eficiência dos serviços construídos e de responsabilidade do seu time;
  • Participar das dinâmicas de trabalho adotadas pelo time;
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa no processo de melhoria contínua do seu time;
  • Colaborar nas definições de arquitetura e escalabilidade dos nossos produtos;
  • Desenvolver e aprimorar a Plataforma de Dados da Neoway;
  • Propor e criar ferramentas e pipelines de dados eficientes;
  • Manter e otimizar a plataforma de dados para ingestão, coleta e distribuição dos dados;
  • Fomentar e evoluir a cultura de engenharia de software no time;
  • Oferecer suporte e consultoria aos engenheiros de dados da plataforma;
  • Trabalhar com linguagens de programação de backend como Golang e Python;
  • Criar soluções com base em uma arquitetura distribuída e de microserviços;
  • Criar soluções resilientes e que estejam dentro dos padrões de alta performance;
  • Demonstrar prudência e cuidado no gerenciamento de grandes volumes de dados;

Para assumir estas responsabilidades você precisa ter as seguintes habilidades:

  • Apresentar boa comunicação, pois somos um time bastante pró ativo e com necessidade de articulação de ideias;
  • Encarar as mudanças como oportunidades e aprender com seus erros.
  • Conhecer sobre processo de desenvolvimento de software, da concepção à entrega e subsequente monitoramento;
  • Facilidade em compartilhar conhecimento com seus pares;
  • Promover o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão;
  • Saber como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutar do trabalho em equipe;
  • Ter experienciado práticas com Code Review e Feedback;
  • Conhecimento avançado em pelo menos uma linguagem de programação;
  • Conhecimento de desenvolvimento na linguagem Golang;
  • Experiência na construção de APIs REST;
  • Experiência em execução de sistemas baseados em containers (Docker);
  • Experiência nos processos de versionamento de código (Git) e práticas de CI/CD;
  • Experiência com banco de dados relacionais e/ou não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB);
  • Conhecimento de infraestrutura e Cloud, de preferência GCP;
  • Conhecimentos básicos sobre Big Data, como por exemplo Datalake, catálogo de esquemas e metadados;

Alguns diferenciais que estamos de olho. Mas não se preocupe caso não tenha, ajudamos você nessa parte:

  • Ter sido responsável por um projeto de ponta a ponta, incluindo desenvolvimento, deploy e monitoramento;
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento e sustentação de sistemas baseados em arquitetura de microsserviços;
  • Experiência com Infra as a Code (Terraform e Ansible);
  • Experiência com Kafka;
  • Experiência com Kubernetes;
  • Experiência com processamento distribuído (e.g., Spark);
  • Expertise com governança de dados: qualidade, linhagem de dados e segurança;
  • Conhecimento avançado sobre Big Data e Plataformas de dados;
  • Experiência com processamento de dados em batch com Apache Beam
  • Experiência com Apache Iceberg
  • Ter trabalhado em time de plataforma na área de Big Data;
  • Desenvolvimento focado no usuário, desde a concepção até o feedback contínuo;

Somos uma consultoria especializada em Data Management, Governança de Dados e Inteligência Artificial , com presença global e reconhecimento do mercado. O que você vai vender
